title: What Is Enjambment? — A Literary Guide for English Students and Teachers
skills: identify enjambed lines in literary texts
analyze how enjambment affects pacing, emphasis, rhythm, and meaning
alignment_note: Explains enjambment as a poetic technique in which a sentence or phrase continues beyond a line break. Supports close reading, analysis of pacing and rhythm, interpretation of poetic structure, and understanding of how lineation influences emphasis and meaning across high school English courses.
